craft_notes: Sthāyin: three sons. Sanskrit-first: names kept whole. Rows: 2. Close: school. Rejected: ranking the views — killed: krameṇa sequences, not ranks. Read aloud: parceling cadence.

lines: Three sons — One, Two, Both — all true.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tryambakāmardakābhikhyaśrīnāthā advaye dvaye | dvayādvaye ca nipuṇāḥ krameṇa śivaśāsane
